We define the energy symbol explicitly by the pattern energy: $E$. The macro form is \EnergySymbol.
The relation is labeled in \cref{eq:energy}, and \Cref{eq:energy} restates it.
\begin{equation}\label{eq:energy}
  \EnergySymbol=\MassSymbol\SpeedSymbol^2.
\end{equation}
See \parencite{OnlineSource} and \textcite{DataSet}.
